## Verified completion

All four guided labs have supporting products. On October 5, 2026, the HPC was accessed as `etdoan` and all 12 required samples were verified. The six Maine quantifications were completed September 21; the six Panama samples were successfully reprocessed September 29 under SLURM job array `536782`, with every task `COMPLETED` and exit code `0:0`.

| Lab | Verified evidence |
|---|---|
| Working with GitHub | Personalized Quarto source, rendered website, new audit entry, and published GitHub repository. |
| Accessing W&M's HPC | Successful SSH access; `sra_prep` and `txpt_quant` environments and required tools installed. |
| Working with SRA Data | Twelve sample-specific QC reports and nonempty trimmed read pairs. The six corrected Panama reports match the course accessions and retain reads. |
| Transcript Quantification | Salmon index and twelve valid `quant.sf` tables on HPC. All twelve local tables match the remote SHA-256 checksums. Local DGE project contains `quant_data`, `metadata`, and `results`. |

Installed versions: fastp 1.3.6, SRA Tools 3.4.1, parallel-fastq-dump 0.6.7, NCBI datasets CLI 18.37.0, Salmon 2.7.0, and STAR 2.7.11b.

## Resolved Panama discrepancy

The first local-only audit could find six Maine results, but could not authenticate to HPC. That limitation is now resolved. The September 29 recovery outputs already existed remotely and passed verification; rerunning those completed analyses was unnecessary.

Two obsolete Panama 29°C reports used `SRR1576466` and `SRR1576467` instead of metadata accessions `SRR1576514` and `SRR1576515`. Their 76-base reads were incompatible with the 80-base cutoff and yielded zero retained reads. The corrected recovery used all six required Panama accessions and retained reads with the course's original filtering parameters. Four obsolete trimmed files in `raw_read_prep` were preserved with `.superseded-20261005` suffixes before the corrected products were linked into place.

Historical daily notes, personal reflections, and the semester-project choice cannot be reconstructed from analysis files and remain explicitly identified as unrecorded elsewhere in the notebook.
